candidates.verified_fact: OS Open UPRN includes residential and commercial properties plus addressable non-postal features such as bus shelters and electricity substations.
candidates.use_rule: UPRN existence alone is not sufficient to create a broadband parcel row; require premises eligibility/property binding.

candidates.verified_fact: bduk_recognised_premises explicitly indicates whether a UPRN is in BDUK's premises base where gigabit connectivity would provide benefit.
candidates.use_rule: Use as a BDUK cross-check eligibility signal; do not override the canonical parcel inventory or Ofcom coverage.

candidates.verified_fact: BDUK publishes struprn with a str prefix specifically to help maintain UPRN data integrity when software reads the files.
candidates.use_rule: Prefer struprn or validated integer parsing during joins so UPRNs are never rounded or converted to scientific notation.

candidates.verified_fact: The official sample exposes UPRN, struprn, bduk_recognised_premises, postcode, current_gigabit, future_gigabit and intervention fields in one row schema.
candidates.use_rule: Use only for parser/schema tests; never extrapolate sample rows to other parcels.

candidates.verified_fact: Ofcom Spring 2026 reports fixed broadband availability separately from full-fibre take-up/active connection counts.
candidates.use_rule: Never treat availability as an active subscription, and never use take-up as proof that every premises in an area can order service.

candidates.verified_fact: NSUL and ONSUD provide Great Britain coverage and are released every six weeks.
candidates.use_rule: Valid for the England slot; do not silently reuse as Northern Ireland coverage.

candidates.verified_fact: BDUK corrected previously identified supplier-name errors and replaced September 2025 release files on 2 February 2026.
candidates.use_rule: Always prefer the latest corrected release and preserve publication/update date in provenance; never join stale supplier-name versions silently.
